content: Hey Linda, how was your day? I couldn't stop thinking about that funny meme you sent me this morning. You always know how to make me smile.
Aww, that means a lot, Daniel. Honestly, chatting with you is the highlight of my day lately.
That makes me so happy to hear. I wish I could be there in person, but until then, our talks mean the world to me. You deserve all the happiness in the world.
You're so sweet. It feels like I've known you forever, even though it's only been a few months.
I feel exactly the same way, Linda. Actually, I've been meaning to share something personal with you, I hope that's okay?
Of course! You know you can tell me anything.

Thank you. Well, I've been finalizing a major investment deal overseas that would allow me to visit you and even support a new life together. But I've just hit a small roadblock with the paperwork fees.
Oh no, what kind of roadblock?

It's nothing serious, just some temporary licensing fees. The lawyers need a $3,000 transfer to process the final documents so the funds can be released. I'm so frustrated, I have all this money tied up, but I can't access it yet.
That sounds stressful. I wish there was something I could do to help.

Honestly, Linda, you being here for me means everything. I wouldn't ask, but if you're able to loan me the fee just for a week or two, I can pay you back double as soon as the contract clears. I want to share all my success with you.
I do have some savings, but $3,000 is a lot. Are you sure it's safe?

Absolutely, darling. I'd never put you at risk. I have all the documents and can show you proof, the transfer just needs to be made to the attorney's escrow account. And I'll update you every step of the way.
Okay... how do I send the money?

Thank you, Linda. You're truly amazing. Here are the bank details: Routing number 038765432, Account number 120987654. If you can wire the amount to 'Parker Legal Trust,' I'll let the attorney know and forward you the receipt.
Alright, I'll head to my bank tomorrow and see what I can do. Can you send me the attorney's name again just to be sure?
Of course, you can double-check everything. The attorney's name is Laura Parker, and she's handling everything for me. I'll send you her business card too. I'm so grateful for you, Linda.
Thanks, Daniel. I trust you. I just want us to finally be together.
We will be, soon. I promise. I can't wait to start a new chapter with you. Just let me know as soon as you've sent the transfer, okay?
I will. I'm a little nervous, but I know you're worth it.
There's nothing to worry about, love. I'm here for you always, and you'll see, this will all be behind us soon. Let me know if you need any help with the bank forms.
Thank you. I'll message you in the morning after I speak to the bank.
